Live truth on 0.2.0-rc.2: the mux transport is {type:'item'|'end'|'error', streamId, value?} and the envelope rides inside `value` (stream-protocol.ts:33-73,252-258; stream-server.ts:176-235). A client that tests the outer frame never sees a ready frame — this exact defect stalled start#1 (see RCA-start1-abort.md).
